name: Fixed-q2 DEPTH Teacher-Reference Ablation
question: Given the exact D1-q2 structural initialization path, does choosing DEPTH layers by minimizing KL against the original Teacher, instead of the FFN-compressed Parent, produce a better initialization for downstream capability recovery?
status: REGISTERED -- $0 readiness only. No paid structural or behavioural session is authorized by this record.

structural_outcomes.NO_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: the treatment keeps q2's layers and every downstream step reproduces q2's bytes (all four final identities equal): preserve the evidence, NO recovery training
structural_outcomes.STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: the treatment keeps a different layer set and its initial checkpoint is new: propose the separately authorized three-probe behavioural rung
structural_outcomes.UNEXPLAINED_BYTE_DIFFERENCE: the same layers and different bytes: diagnose the materialization; nothing is called a scientific effect

contract._reference_support: the Top-K support of a reference-defined sketch is the REFERENCE's own Top-K, so switching the reference from the parent to the teacher switches which token ids form the support. That is the declared reference switch itself, not D2's reference_student_union_topk_tail_v1

treatment.downstream: RESIDUAL_WIDTH and ATTENTION are recomputed on the actual new parent; q2's downstream digests are never forced onto changed weights
treatment.kl: forward KL on the REFERENCE-defined Top-200 + aggregate tail (reference_topk_tail_v1, K=200), both arms
not_introduced_from_d2: D2's structural path or selected initializations
treatment.objective_control: KL(P || C(S)) -- P: the 36-layer parent after q2's frozen FFN step
treatment.objective_treatment: KL(T || C(S)) -- T: the original, uncompressed teacher
treatment.parent_reference_diagnostics: every candidate of every round, from the same candidate logits, after the decision value; never read by the selection
treatment.reference_support_note: the Top-K support of a reference-defined sketch is the REFERENCE's own Top-K, so switching the reference from the parent to the teacher switches which token ids form the support. That is the declared reference switch itself, not D2's reference_student_union_topk_tail_v1

teacher_reference.built_from: the original teacher, before any compression, while the root is held (materialize_fixed_path)
fails_closed_on: a store with no execution binding
teacher_reference.rows: every real prediction position; DEPTH's position policy selects among them
